title: A cross-modal generative model for incomplete and degraded prostate MRI with multicentre clinical validation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Missing or degraded sequences can limit prostate multiparametric MRI. We developed MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative framework for reconstructing unavailable contrasts and restoring degraded acquisitions. Across ten completion tasks, task-specific MSCNet achieved mean structural similarity of 0.818 versus 0.798 for the strongest task-matched comparators; matched-capacity analyses showed larger differences in lesion fidelity and boundary preservation. In a blinded 1,000-case reader study, overall image quality met the prespecified non-inferiority criterion for DWI, ADC and T2W completion, but not T1W. In a separate 200-case diagnostic assessment, AUCs for clinically significant cancer were 0.860 with acquired images, 0.841 with MSCNet and 0.797 with baseline-generated images. translated_title: 一种用于不完整和退化前列腺MRI的跨模态生成模型及多中心临床验证
translated_abstract: 缺失或退化的序列可能限制前列腺多参数MRI的应用。我们开发了MSCNet，一种序列条件化的跨模态生成框架，用于重建不可用的对比度并恢复退化的采集。在十项完成任务中，任务特定MSCNet实现了平均结构相似性为0.818，而最强任务匹配比较器为0.798；匹配容量分析显示在病变保真度和边界保留方面存在更大差异。在一项设盲的1000例读者研究中，整体图像质量达到了DWI、ADC和T2W完成的预设非劣效性标准，但T1W未达到。在另一项200例诊断评估中，临床显著癌症的AUC在采集图像中为0.860，MSCNet为0.841，基线生成图像为0.797。一个锁定的186例三医院队列支持多中心可移植性。这些回顾性结果支持质量控制的跨模态生成。
tldr: 本文提出了MSCNet，一种序列条件化跨模态生成模型，能有效重建缺失或退化的前列腺MRI序列，并在多中心临床验证中展现出非劣效性图像质量和诊断性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MSCNet, a sequence-conditioned cross-modal generative model that effectively reconstructs missing or degraded prostate MRI sequences, demonstrating non-inferior image quality and diagnostic performance in multicentre clinical validation.
